title: Slide, which develops data backup and disaster recovery tech for managed service providers, raised a $70M Series B led by GC, bringing its total funding to $95M (CJ Fairfield/CRN)
summary: CJ Fairfield / CRN: Slide, which develops data backup and disaster recovery tech for managed service providers, raised a $70M Series B led by GC, bringing its total funding to $95M — 'We're using this additional funding to continue to put our foot on the accelerator so that we can grow the business …
